sentences.en: Some people say stepping on a worm makes it rain.
sentences.zh: 有些人说踩到虫子就会下雨。

sentences.en: I really opened up a can of worms, didn't I?
sentences.zh: 我真是捅了马蜂窝了吧？

sentences.en: Some birds eat seeds and fruits, others insects or worms.
sentences.zh: 有些鸟吃种子和果实，有些吃昆虫或蠕虫。

senses.zh: 使蠕动；给除虫；使缓慢前进
